g.text: Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV charger); T17 = tray_id 17; A, B = AGVs; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90},
